moved.sentence: **response-caching**: Identical or semantically equivalent requests MUST be cached.

judged.note: Kept at MUST for identical or semantically equivalent requests; the TTL-depends-on-use-case note is kept.

moved.sentence: Cache key includes: model, prompt template ID, template variables, temperature (if 0).

judged.note: All four key components kept, including the temperature-if-0 condition; the unkeyed statement is kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: **cost-budgets**: Every AI-powered feature MUST define a per-user and per-request cost budget.

judged.note: Kept at MUST: every AI-powered feature defines both a per-user and a per-request budget.

moved.sentence: **tiered-model-selection**: Systems SHOULD route requests to the cheapest model that meets quality requirements.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the quality-requirement condition and the Haiku/Sonnet/Opus example.

moved.sentence: **batch-over-realtime**: Non-latency-sensitive work SHOULD use batch APIs (typically 50% cheaper) rather than real-time endpoints.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the non-latency-sensitive scope and the typically-50%-cheaper reason.

moved.sentence: **cost-per-request-tracking**: Every API response MUST record actual cost (input tokens times price plus output tokens times price).

judged.note: Kept at MUST with the cost formula (input tokens times price plus output tokens times price).

moved.sentence: **provider-fallback**: Systems SHOULD define fallback providers for availability and cost.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD for both availability and cost, with the traffic-shift note.
